question: Which oil kept the uranium bullet sliding in the gun-type bomb's barrel?
answer: The gun-type bomb fires a uranium bullet down a barrel into a uranium target. Synthetic oils dried up, so the only oil that worked came from sperm whales. The reveal is that whale oil was at the heart of the bomb.
move: At the heart of the bomb sat whale oil: synthetic oils dried up.

web.label: Quiz asking which oil kept a uranium bullet sliding down the barrel of a gun-type bomb. Three choices: the best synthetic machine oil, oil from sperm whales, or no oil at all with polished dry metal. The reader picks one, then can watch the bullet fire.

source: Veritasium, “The Man Who Gave us the Power To Destroy Ourselves (Oppenheimer)” (YouTube, 2023)
